use_case_name: Respond to a Second-Chance Purchase Offer

claims.content: The customer purchases an item at their last bid price after being offered a second chance due to the original winner's non-payment.

goal.raw_text: The customer purchases an item at their last bid price after being offered a second chance due to the original winner's non-payment.

claims.content: Customer
The original winning bidder must have failed to pay for the item within 7 days (168 hours) of the auction ending time.
The original winner's order must be cancelled and the item placed into a "hold" status.
There must be a second-place finisher for the auctioned item.
The second-place finisher's last bid price must not be below the item's unit cost.

The second-place finisher must not be identified as bidding against themselves (e.g., having two accounts with matching name, phone, email, member ID, or billing/shipping addresses compared to the original winner).
The customer receives an automated email offering to sell the item at their last bid price after the original winning bidder's order is cancelled for non-payment.

trigger.raw_text: The customer receives an automated email offering to sell the item at their last bid price after the original winning bidder's order is cancelled for non-payment.

claims.content: The customer receives an automated email offering the item at their last bid price with three response options.
If choosing the Credit Card Option, the customer clicks the 'I accept, pay with my On File credit card' button within three days of the email being sent.
Upon clicking the credit card acceptance button, an automated process generates the order and ships the item, requiring no further action from the customer.
If choosing the PayPal or Amazon Payments Option, the customer clicks the 'Pay with PayPal or Amazon Payments' button within three days of the email being sent.
Clicking the PayPal/Amazon button generates the order and loads the Sign-In page.
After signing in, the customer is taken to the Returning Winners Payments Page to complete payment for the order.
If choosing to decline, the customer clicks the 'No Thanks' button, which releases the item from hold status back into auction available inventory.
If the customer does not respond to the second-chance email within 72 hours after it is sent, the item is returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
If the customer does not respond to the second-chance email within 72 hours after it is sent, the item is returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
The second-chance email will not be sent if the second-place finisher's bid is below the item's unit cost.

The second-chance email will not be sent if the system detects that the recipient has two accounts and is bidding against themselves (matches found on Customer Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Member ID, or Billing/Shipping Addresses compared to the Winner's account data).
If the customer accepts via the Credit Card Option, the system generates the order and ships the item automatically, requiring no further action from the customer.
If the customer accepts via the PayPal or Amazon Payments Option, the system generates the order and directs the customer to the Returning Winners Payments Page to complete the payment.
If the customer declines the offer, the item is released from 'hold' status and returned to auction available inventory.
